how_to_add: Add one block to campaigns, in the order the cards should show. The page draws each block as its own card.

name: the campaign. hub: the core piece. kind is what it is (Blog, Webinar, Event, Press release, Report), title and date, plus link if there is one. short_title is an optional shorter title for the diagram.
For visits, give hub.visits_path (an opsera.ai path). The page counts Google Analytics visits from hub.date, or from visits_from, to visits_to if given. Or give hub.number as text.
spokes: each has group (Format or Channel) and name, plus link, visits_path or number as text.
source is the line under the card. numbers_note says where the numbers came from and when.
note: an optional short label under the campaign name, for example "Runs into Q4, counted from 28 Oct".
Never put people's emails or a single customer's deal in this file: it is public.
